title: Ore blocks trail datapack
description: This datapack creates ore block trails
body:
# Ore blocks trail datapack

This datapack gives you an ore block trail corresponding to the ore block you hold and and emerald particle trail

## Features

1. **Trail Effect:**
   - When you hold an ore block (e.g., a diamond block), a corresponding trail appears behind you. 
   
2. **Emerald Particle Trail:**
   - An emerald particle trail activates when you use or stand on an ore block.

## Notes
- This datapack is based on my previous creation, the Diamond Trail datapack.
- The trail effect does not work with Redstone blocks.

Enjoy!
